meta.title: 英语单词本地补全词库（人工编写，零 AI 调用）
meta.note: 本词库内容为离线编写、随应用发布，补全时不调用任何付费 AI 接口，也不发起网络请求。每条含：多义项释义(defs)、分档例句(examples，含长难句解析 analysis)、词组搭配(collocations)、短语(phrases)、派生词(derived)、词根词缀(rootAffix)、近义词(synonyms)、助记(mnemonic)。未收录的词一律明确提示跳过，绝不臆造。

schema.examples[].analysis: 长难句解析：句子结构、从句、特殊句式与词义在此语境下的取义

abandon.rootAffix: a-(去，向)+bandon(控制、管辖权) → 交出控制权 → 放弃

examples.sentence: He abandoned his car in the snow and walked home.
examples.translation: 他把车丢在雪地里，步行回家。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 He + 谓语 abandoned + 宾语 his car，连词 and 并列第二个谓语 walked。abandon 此处取「丢弃、遗弃」义，宾语为具体物品。

examples.sentence: Although the researchers had invested years in the project, they were forced to abandon it when the funding agency withdrew its support, leaving a great deal of preliminary data unused.
examples.translation: 尽管研究者在该项目上投入了数年，但在资助机构撤回支持后，他们被迫放弃，致使大量前期数据闲置。
examples.analysis: 主从复合句。Although 引导让步状语从句（had invested 为过去完成时，表先于主句发生）；主句 they were forced to abandon it 为被动结构；when 引导时间状语从句；句末 leaving... 为现在分词短语作结果状语。abandon 取「中止、放弃」义，宾语为抽象事物 project。

collocations: abandon one's hope 放弃希望
abandon the plan 放弃计划
phrases: abandon hope of 放弃…的希望
with abandon 放纵地；尽情地
abandon.mnemonic: a-(一个)+band(乐队)+on → 一个乐队散了 → 放弃、抛弃

defs.meaning: 废除，废止（法律、制度、习俗等）

abolish.rootAffix: ab-(离开、去掉)+ol(生长)+-ish(动词后缀) → 使其不再生长 → 废止

examples.sentence: Parliament voted to abolish the tax.
examples.translation: 议会投票废除了这项税收。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Parliament + 谓语 voted + 不定式 to abolish the tax 作宾语。abolish 的宾语常为法律、制度、税收等制度性名词。

examples.sentence: The reformers argued that slavery would not disappear of its own accord, and that only legislation could abolish an institution so deeply rooted in the economic life of the region.
examples.translation: 改革者主张，奴隶制不会自行消亡，唯有立法才能废除这一在该地区经济生活中根深蒂固的制度。
examples.analysis: 多重复合句。主句 The reformers argued 后接两个由 that 引导的并列宾语从句（第二个 that 不可省略）；第二从句中 so deeply rooted in... 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 institution。abolish 强调通过法律或正式手段彻底终止。

collocations: abolish the death penalty 废除死刑
abolish a law 废除法律
abolish the monarchy 废除君主制
phrases: abolish...altogether 彻底废除
vote to abolish 投票废除
abolish.mnemonic: ab-(去掉)+olish → 去掉旧制 → 废除

absorb.rootAffix: ab-(离开、去掉)+sorb(吸收) → 吸走 → 吸收

examples.sentence: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
examples.translation: 植物从空气中吸收二氧化碳。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Plants + 谓语 absorb + 宾语 carbon dioxide + 状语 from the air。此处为「吸收物质」的本义。

examples.sentence: So rapidly did the young chemist absorb the new theory that within a year she was able to apply it to problems her supervisors had considered intractable.
examples.translation: 这位年轻的化学家吸收新理论的速度如此之快，以至于一年内她已能将其用于导师们曾认为棘手的问题。
examples.analysis: 倒装 + 结果状语从句。句首 So rapidly 提前引起部分倒装（助动词 did 提至主语 the young chemist 之前）；that 引导结果状语从句；从句中 her supervisors had considered intractable 为省略关系代词的定语从句修饰 problems。absorb 取「理解、掌握」的引申义。

collocations: absorb the impact 缓冲冲击
phrases: absorb...into 把…吸收进/并入
be absorbed by 被…吸收；被…吸引

derived.meaning: adj. 能吸收的 n. 吸收剂

absorb.mnemonic: ab-(加强)+sorb(吸) → 吸进去 → 吸收

abstract.rootAffix: abs-(离开)+tract(拉) → 从具体中抽出来 → 抽象

examples.sentence: The idea of justice is abstract.
examples.translation: 正义的概念是抽象的。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 The idea of justice + 系动词 is + 表语 abstract。abstract 作形容词，与 concrete（具体的）相对。

examples.sentence: While the lecture began with a series of concrete case studies, it gradually moved towards more abstract questions about the nature of responsibility, which many students found difficult to follow.
examples.translation: 讲座虽以一系列具体案例开篇，却逐渐转向关于责任本质的更抽象问题，许多学生感到难以跟上。
examples.analysis: 复合句。While 引导让步状语从句（此处相当于 although，不表时间）；主句 it gradually moved towards...；句末 which 引导非限制性定语从句，修饰整个主句内容。句中 abstract 与 concrete 形成对比。

collocations: in the abstract 抽象地；理论上
phrases: abstract...from 从…中提取
make an abstract of 做…的摘要
abstract.mnemonic: abs-(离开)+tract(拉) → 从具体中拉出来 → 抽象

defs.meaning: 荒谬的，荒唐的，不合理的

absurd.rootAffix: ab-(加强)+surd(聋；不合理) → 不合常理 → 荒谬

examples.sentence: It was absurd to blame him for the accident.
examples.translation: 把事故归咎于他是荒谬的。
examples.analysis: 简单句：it 作形式主语，真正主语为不定式短语 to blame him for the accident。absurd 常用于 It is absurd to do 结构。

examples.sentence: The proposal that the university should charge students for library access seemed so absurd that it was withdrawn almost as soon as it was published.
examples.translation: 大学应向学生收取图书馆使用费这一提议显得如此荒谬，以至于几乎在公布的同时就被撤回了。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主语 The proposal 后接 that 引导的同位语从句（说明 proposal 的具体内容）；so...that 引导结果状语从句；从句内含 as soon as 引导的时间状语从句。absurd 强调违背常理到令人发笑。

collocations: absurd to suppose 假设…是荒谬的
phrases: it is absurd to 做…是荒谬的
the absurd 荒诞（的事物）
absurd.mnemonic: ab-(加强)+surd(音似「傻的」) → 荒谬的

abundant.rootAffix: ab-(加强)+und(波浪)+-ant(形容词后缀) → 如波涛般涌来 → 丰富的

examples.sentence: The region has abundant natural resources.
examples.translation: 该地区拥有丰富的自然资源。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 The region + 谓语 has + 宾语 abundant natural resources。abundant 作定语修饰 resources。

examples.sentence: Evidence that dietary fibre protects against certain diseases is now abundant, yet many people still consume far less than the amount recommended by health authorities.
examples.translation: 膳食纤维可预防某些疾病的证据如今已十分充分，然而许多人的摄入量仍远低于卫生部门推荐的水平。
examples.analysis: 并列复合句（yet 连接两个分句）。第一分句中 that 引导同位语从句，修饰主语 Evidence；第二分句中 far less than the amount recommended by health authorities 含比较结构与过去分词短语作后置定语。abundant 在此作表语。

phrases: be abundant in 富含；盛产
an abundance of 大量的
abundant.mnemonic: ab-(加强)+und(波浪)+ant → 波涛般涌来 → 丰富的

abuse.rootAffix: ab-(离开、偏离)+use(使用) → 偏离正当地使用 → 滥用

examples.sentence: He abused his position as manager.
examples.translation: 他滥用了经理的职权。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 He + 谓语 abused + 宾语 his position + 定语 as manager。abuse 取「滥用（权力）」义。

examples.sentence: What disturbed the investigators most was not merely that the funds had been misused, but that the abuse had continued for years without anyone in authority noticing.
examples.translation: 最令调查者不安的不仅是资金被挪用，而是这种滥用持续了数年，竟无一位当权者察觉。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主语为 What 引导的主语从句；表语由 not merely that... but that... 两个并列的表语从句构成；第二从句中 without anyone in authority noticing 为 without 复合结构（宾语 + 现在分词）作伴随状语。

collocations: abuse of power 滥用权力
phrases: abuse one's authority 滥用职权
open to abuse 易被滥用
abuse.mnemonic: ab-(偏离)+use(用) → 用得不对 → 滥用

academic.rootAffix: 源自 Akademia（柏拉图讲学的园林）→ 学术的

examples.sentence: She has an excellent academic record.
examples.translation: 她有出色的学业成绩。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 She + 谓语 has + 宾语 an excellent academic record。academic 作定语，此处指「学业的」。

examples.sentence: Whether the new curriculum will raise standards or merely add to teachers' workload is still an open question, and one that many academics believe cannot be settled without long-term research.
examples.translation: 新课程究竟会提高水准还是仅仅增加教师负担，仍是一个悬而未决的问题，且许多学者认为不经过长期研究便无法定论。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主语为 Whether...or... 引导的主语从句；主句 is still an open question；and one that... 中 one 指代 question，后接 that 引导的定语从句，从句内又含被动结构 cannot be settled。academics 在此作名词「大学教师、学者」。

phrases: academic circle 学术界
purely academic 纯理论的；不切实际的

derived.meaning: n. 学会；研究院；专科学校

academic.mnemonic: 源自柏拉图讲学的 Akademia 园林 → 学术的

accelerate.rootAffix: ac-(加强)+celer(快速)+-ate(动词后缀) → 使更快

examples.sentence: The car accelerated to overtake the truck.
examples.translation: 汽车加速以超越卡车。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 The car + 谓语 accelerated + 不定式 to overtake the truck 作目的状语。accelerate 为「加速」本义。

examples.sentence: If global warming continues to accelerate, the rate at which species disappear may soon exceed anything recorded in the fossil record.
examples.translation: 如果全球变暖继续加速，物种消失的速度可能很快超过化石记录中所记载的任何时期。
examples.analysis: 复合句。If 引导条件状语从句；主句中 the rate 后接 at which 引导的定语从句（介词 at + 关系代词，源自 at the rate）；句末 anything recorded in the fossil record 含过去分词短语作后置定语。

collocations: accelerate the process 加快进程
accelerate economic development 加快经济发展
phrases: accelerate...by 以…加速
accelerate away 加速驶离

accommodate.rootAffix: ac-(向)+com-(共同)+mod(方式、尺度)+-ate → 使尺寸相合 → 容纳

examples.sentence: The hall can accommodate 500 people.
examples.translation: 这个礼堂可容纳 500 人。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 The hall + 情态动词 can + 谓语 accommodate + 宾语 500 people。accommodate 取「容纳」义，主语常为空间或设施。

examples.sentence: Rather than expecting newcomers to accommodate themselves to existing routines, the department revised its procedures so that different working styles could be supported.
examples.translation: 该部门并未指望新人去适应既有流程，而是修订了程序，以便支持不同的工作风格。
examples.analysis: 复合句。句首 Rather than 后接动名词 expecting... 作对比状语，其中含 accommodate oneself to 结构；主句 the department revised its procedures；so that 引导目的状语从句（含被动 could be supported）。

collocations: accommodate a need 满足需求
accommodate up to 最多容纳
phrases: accommodate oneself to 使自己适应
be accommodated in 被安置在

derived.meaning: adj. 乐于助人的；随和的

accommodate.mnemonic: ac+com(共同)+mod(模式)+ate → 调到同一模式 → 容纳/适应

accompany.rootAffix: ac-(向)+com-(共同)+pan(面包)+-y → 一同分食面包的人 → 同伴

examples.sentence: She accompanied her mother to the station.
examples.translation: 她陪母亲去了车站。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 She + 谓语 accompanied + 宾语 her mother + 状语 to the station。accompany 为及物动词，后直接接人，不加介词。

examples.sentence: The rapid rise in unemployment was accompanied by a sharp increase in crime, a pattern that has been observed in every recession since the 1970s.
examples.translation: 失业率的急剧上升伴随着犯罪率的猛增，这一模式自 1970 年代以来在每次经济衰退中都能见到。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主句为被动结构 was accompanied by；a pattern 为同位语，概括前文整个现象，后接 that 引导的定语从句；从句中 since the 1970s 为时间状语，与现在完成时 has been observed 呼应。

collocations: accompany sb to 陪某人去
be accompanied by 伴随着；由…陪同
accompany on the piano 用钢琴伴奏
phrases: accompany...with 以…伴随
accompanying circumstances 伴随情况
accompany.mnemonic: ac+com(共同)+pany(同伴) → 一起去 → 陪伴

accomplish.rootAffix: ac-(向)+com-(完全)+pl(填满)+-ish → 填满至完成 → 完成

examples.sentence: They accomplished the task ahead of schedule.
examples.translation: 他们提前完成了任务。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 They + 谓语 accomplished + 宾语 the task + 状语 ahead of schedule。accomplish 强调成功完成有一定难度的事。

examples.sentence: Little of what the committee set out to accomplish has actually been achieved, largely because the members could not agree on priorities.
examples.translation: 委员会着手要完成的事情中，实际达成的寥寥无几，主要因为成员们无法就优先事项达成一致。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主语 Little of what... 中 what 引导的从句作介词 of 的宾语；谓语 has been achieved 为现在完成时的被动；because 引导原因状语从句，其中含固定搭配 agree on。

collocations: accomplish a goal 实现目标
accomplish a task 完成任务
phrases: accomplish...through 通过…完成
be accomplished in 擅长；精通
accomplish.mnemonic: ac+com(完全)+plish(完成) → 全部做完 → 完成

accumulate.rootAffix: ac-(加强)+cumul(堆积)+-ate → 不断堆积 → 积累

examples.sentence: He accumulated a large fortune.
examples.translation: 他积累了大笔财富。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 He + 谓语 accumulated + 宾语 a large fortune。accumulate 取「积累（财富、经验）」义。

examples.sentence: Dust had accumulated on the shelves for so long that removing it required masks, and the air in the room became difficult to breathe.
examples.translation: 架子上积了太久的灰尘，清理时甚至需要戴口罩，房间里的空气也变得难以呼吸。
examples.analysis: 并列复合句。第一分句含 so...that 引导的结果状语从句（主语 Dust，谓语 had accumulated 为过去完成时，表先于清理发生）；第二分句 the air...became difficult to breathe 中不定式 to breathe 用主动形式表被动含义。

phrases: accumulate...over time 随时间积累
accumulated interest 累计利息
accumulate.mnemonic: ac+cumul(堆积)+ate → 越堆越多 → 积累

accurate.rootAffix: ac-(向)+cur(关心、照料)+-ate → 精心对待 → 精确

examples.sentence: The report gives an accurate account of the events.
examples.translation: 报告准确地记述了事件经过。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 The report + 谓语 gives + 宾语 an accurate account + 定语 of the events。accurate 作定语修饰 account。

examples.sentence: For the conclusions to be accurate, the data must be collected under conditions that can be reproduced by other researchers.
examples.translation: 为使结论准确，数据必须在其他研究者可复现的条件下采集。
examples.analysis: 复合句。句首 For the conclusions to be accurate 为 for 复合不定式结构，作目的/条件状语；主句 the data must be collected 为含情态动词的被动；that 引导定语从句修饰 conditions，从句内亦为被动 can be reproduced。

phrases: be accurate in 在…方面准确
accurate account 准确的描述
accurate.mnemonic: ac+cur(关心)+ate → 精心对待 → 准确的

accuse.rootAffix: ac-(向)+cuse(理由、诉讼) → 提出诉讼 → 指控

examples.sentence: She accused him of lying.
examples.translation: 她指责他撒谎。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 She + 谓语 accused + 宾语 him + of lying。注意固定搭配 accuse sb of (doing) sth，介词 of 后接动名词。

examples.sentence: The company was accused of having concealed evidence that its products were unsafe, a charge it denied for more than a decade.
examples.translation: 该公司被指控隐瞒其产品不安全的证据，这一指控被其否认了十多年。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主句为被动 was accused of，后接动名词的完成式 having concealed（表先于指控发生）；that 引导定语从句修饰 evidence；a charge 为同位语，后接省略关系代词的定语从句 it denied...。

collocations: accuse sb of 指控某人…
accuse of theft 指控盗窃
phrases: accuse...of doing 指控…做了
the accused 被告
accuse.mnemonic: ac+cuse(诉讼) → 提起诉讼 → 指控

achieve.rootAffix: a-(向)+chief(头、顶端) → 到达顶端 → 实现

examples.sentence: He achieved his goal of running a marathon.
examples.translation: 他实现了跑马拉松的目标。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 He + 谓语 achieved + 宾语 his goal + 定语 of running a marathon。achieve 的宾语常为 goal、aim、result 等。

examples.sentence: What the reforms achieved was not so much a reduction in costs as a change in the way resources were allocated across departments.
examples.translation: 这些改革所取得的，与其说是成本的降低，不如说是资源在各部门间分配方式的改变。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主语为 What 引导的主语从句；主句谓语为 not so much A as B 结构（与其说是 A 不如说是 B）；B 部分中 the way 后接省略 that/in which 的定语从句 resources were allocated...。

collocations: achieve a goal 实现目标
phrases: achieve...through 通过…实现
achieve one's potential 发挥潜能
achieve.mnemonic: a(到)+chief(顶端) → 到顶端 → 实现

acknowledge.rootAffix: ac-(加强)+knowledge(知晓) → 使知晓 → 承认

examples.sentence: He acknowledged his mistake.
examples.translation: 他承认了自己的错误。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 He + 谓语 acknowledged + 宾语 his mistake。acknowledge 后可直接接名词，也可接 that 从句或动名词。

examples.sentence: Although the author acknowledged that her conclusions were preliminary, she argued that they were consistent with findings reported by several independent groups.
examples.translation: 尽管作者承认其结论是初步的，但她主张这些结论与若干独立研究团队所报告的发现相一致。
examples.analysis: 复合句。Although 引导让步状语从句，从句中 that 引导宾语从句；主句 she argued 后接 that 宾语从句；consistent with findings reported by... 中 reported 为过去分词短语作后置定语。

collocations: acknowledge a mistake 承认错误
acknowledge the fact 承认事实
phrases: acknowledge...as 承认…是
acknowledge that 承认…
acknowledge.mnemonic: ac+knowledge(知道) → 让人知道 → 承认

defs.meaning: 获得，取得（技能、知识、财产等）

acquire.rootAffix: ac-(向)+quir(寻求)+-e → 去寻求 → 获得

examples.sentence: Children acquire language naturally.
examples.translation: 儿童自然地习得语言。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Children + 谓语 acquire + 宾语 language + 状语 naturally。acquire 强调潜移默化地习得（语言、技能）。

examples.sentence: It is often argued that the skills acquired at university matter less than the ability to acquire new ones as circumstances change.
examples.translation: 人们常说，大学里学到的技能不如随环境变化而获取新技能的能力重要。
examples.analysis: 复合句。It 为形式主语，真正主语为 that 引导的主语从句；从句中 acquired at university 为过去分词短语作后置定语修饰 skills；比较结构 matter less than...；句末 to acquire new ones 为不定式作 ability 的定语。

collocations: acquire a skill 掌握技能
acquire a habit 养成习惯
phrases: acquire...from 从…获得
acquire a taste for 逐渐喜欢上
acquire.mnemonic: ac+quir(寻求)+e → 寻求得到 → 获得

adapt.rootAffix: ad-(向)+apt(适合) → 使适合 → 适应

examples.sentence: It took him a while to adapt to the new school.
examples.translation: 他花了一些时间才适应新学校。
examples.analysis: It took sb time to do 句型：it 为形式主语，真正主语为不定式 to adapt to the new school。adapt 后接 to + 名词/动名词。

examples.sentence: Species that fail to adapt to changing conditions either migrate or disappear, and the fossil record shows that the latter has been far more common.
examples.translation: 未能适应环境变化的物种要么迁徙，要么消失，而化石记录表明后者远为常见。
examples.analysis: 并列复合句。第一分句中 that fail to adapt... 为定语从句修饰 Species，either...or... 连接并列谓语；第二分句中 that 引导宾语从句，the latter 指代前文 disappear。

collocations: adapt oneself to 使自己适应
phrases: adapt...to 使…适应
be adapted from 改编自
adapt.mnemonic: ad(去)+apt(适合) → 去适合 → 适应

adequate.rootAffix: ad-(向)+equ(相等)+-ate → 与需求相等 → 足够

examples.sentence: The lighting here is not adequate for reading.
examples.translation: 这里的光线不足以阅读。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 The lighting + 系动词 is + 表语 not adequate + 状语 for reading。adequate for 表示「对…而言足够」。

examples.sentence: Unless adequate funding is provided, the programme will be unable to serve the population for which it was designed.
examples.translation: 除非提供充足的资金，该项目将无法服务其目标人群。
examples.analysis: 复合句。Unless 引导条件状语从句（含被动 is provided）；主句 will be unable to serve；句末 for which it was designed 为「介词 + 关系代词」引导的定语从句，修饰 the population。

phrases: be adequate to 胜任；足以应付
adequate to the task 能胜任任务
adequate.mnemonic: ad+equ(相等)+ate → 与需求相等 → 足够的

adhere.rootAffix: ad-(向)+her(黏) → 黏上去 → 黏附/坚持

examples.sentence: All members must adhere to the rules.
examples.translation: 所有成员都必须遵守规则。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 All members + 情态动词 must + 谓语 adhere + to the rules。adhere to 为固定搭配，后接规则、原则、标准等。

examples.sentence: Firms that adhere strictly to the guidelines are less likely to face penalties, though compliance can be costly in the short term.
examples.translation: 严格遵守准则的企业受处罚的可能性较小，尽管短期合规成本可能很高。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主句主语 Firms 后接 that 引导的定语从句；be likely to 结构；though 引导让步状语从句，其中 compliance 为名词化作主语。

collocations: adhere to a principle 坚持原则
phrases: adhere to the letter 严格遵守字面规定
adhere together 黏在一起

derived.meaning: n. 拥护者 adj. 黏附的
adj. 有黏性的 n. 黏合剂

adhere.mnemonic: ad(去)+here(黏) → 黏上去 → 坚持/黏附

adjust.rootAffix: ad-(向)+just(正确、公正) → 使正确 → 调整

examples.sentence: You can adjust the seat to your height.
examples.translation: 你可以按身高调节座椅。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 You + 情态动词 can + 谓语 adjust + 宾语 the seat + 状语 to your height。adjust 取「调节」义。

examples.sentence: Having spent years in a highly structured environment, she found it difficult to adjust to a job in which priorities changed from day to day.
examples.translation: 在高度结构化的环境中待了多年后，她发现很难适应一份优先事项每天都在变的工作。
examples.analysis: 复合句。句首 Having spent... 为现在分词的完成式作原因状语（表先于主句发生）；主句 she found it difficult to adjust... 中 it 为形式宾语；句末 in which 引导定语从句修饰 a job。

collocations: adjust the settings 调整设置
adjust a policy 调整政策
phrases: adjust oneself to 使自己适应
adjust...accordingly 相应调整
adjust.mnemonic: ad+just(正确) → 弄正确 → 调整

admit.rootAffix: ad-(向)+mit(送、放) → 放进去 → 接纳/承认

examples.sentence: He admitted that he was wrong.
examples.translation: 他承认自己错了。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 He + 谓语 admitted + that 引导的宾语从句。admit 后可接名词、that 从句或动名词，但不接不定式。

examples.sentence: Not until the final audit did the department admit that the figures it had published for the previous three years were unreliable.
examples.translation: 直到最后一次审计，该部门才承认其此前三年公布的数据不可靠。
examples.analysis: 倒装句。Not until 置于句首引起主句部分倒装（助动词 did 提至主语 the department 之前）；that 引导宾语从句；从句中 it had published for the previous three years 为省略关系代词的定语从句修饰 the figures。

collocations: admit a mistake 承认错误
admit to doing 承认做了
be admitted to 被…录取/接纳
phrases: admit...into 准许…进入
admit of 容许；有…的余地
admit.mnemonic: ad+mit(送) → 放进来 → 接纳/承认

adopt.rootAffix: ad-(向)+opt(选择) → 选来用 → 采用

examples.sentence: The committee adopted the proposal.
examples.translation: 委员会采纳了这项提议。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 The committee + 谓语 adopted + 宾语 the proposal。adopt 取「正式采纳」义。

examples.sentence: Countries that adopted the measure early reported fewer hospital admissions than those which waited until the outbreak was already widespread.
examples.translation: 较早采取该措施的国家，其住院人数少于等到疫情已广泛蔓延才行动的国家。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主句主语 Countries 后接 that 引导的定语从句；比较结构 fewer... than those；those 后接 which 引导的定语从句；until 引导时间状语从句，其中 was already widespread 为系表结构。

collocations: adopt a policy 采取政策
adopt an approach 采用方法
adopt a child 收养孩子
phrases: adopt...as 把…作为…采用
adopt a resolution 通过决议
adopt.mnemonic: ad+opt(选择) → 选来用 → 采用

advocate.rootAffix: ad-(向)+voc(叫喊)+-ate → 为…呼喊 → 提倡

examples.sentence: She advocates a more flexible approach.
examples.translation: 她提倡更灵活的方法。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 She + 谓语 advocates + 宾语 a more flexible approach。advocate 作动词时后接名词或动名词，不接不定式。

examples.sentence: Those who advocate cutting public spending argue that the resulting savings outweigh the short-term costs, a claim that remains fiercely contested.
examples.translation: 主张削减公共开支的人认为，由此节省的开支超过短期代价，这一说法仍受到激烈质疑。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主语 Those 后接 who 引导的定语从句；谓语 argue 后接 that 宾语从句；句末 a claim 为同位语，后接 that 引导的定语从句（含被动 remains contested）。advocate 后接动名词 cutting。

collocations: advocate a policy 主张一项政策
strong advocate 坚定的拥护者
advocate of reform 改革的倡导者
phrases: advocate doing 主张做
an advocate of …的拥护者
advocate.mnemonic: ad+voc(喊)+ate → 为…呐喊 → 提倡

affect.rootAffix: af-(向)+fect(做、作用于) → 作用于 → 影响

examples.sentence: Bad weather affected the harvest.
examples.translation: 恶劣天气影响了收成。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Bad weather + 谓语 affected + 宾语 the harvest。affect 为及物动词，宾语即被影响的对象（注意与名词 effect「结果」区分）。

examples.sentence: How deeply children are affected by what they see online depends less on the amount of time spent than on whether adults discuss it with them.
examples.translation: 儿童受其所见网络内容影响的程度，与其说取决于上网时长，不如说取决于成人是否与之讨论。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主语为 How 引导的主语从句（含被动 are affected by）；谓语为 depends less on A than on B 比较结构；A 中 spent 为过去分词作后置定语修饰 time；B 为 whether 引导的宾语从句。

collocations: affect the outcome 影响结果
phrases: affect...deeply 深受影响
be deeply affected 深受感动
affect.mnemonic: af+fect(做) → 对…起作用 → 影响

aggressive.rootAffix: ag-(向)+gress(走)+-ive → 走向对方 → 侵略

examples.sentence: He became aggressive after drinking.
examples.translation: 他酒后变得好斗。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 He + 系动词 became + 表语 aggressive + 状语 after drinking。aggressive 作表语，此处为「好斗的」贬义。

examples.sentence: While an aggressive marketing campaign may boost sales in the short term, it can damage a brand's reputation if customers feel they are being manipulated.
examples.translation: 虽然激进的营销活动可能在短期提振销量，但若顾客感到被操纵，则可能损害品牌声誉。
examples.analysis: 复合句。While 引导让步状语从句；主句 it can damage...；if 引导条件状语从句；从句中 they are being manipulated 为现在进行时的被动。aggressive 此处为「积极进取的」中性义。

collocations: increasingly aggressive 越来越咄咄逼人
phrases: be aggressive towards 对…气势汹汹
aggressive in pursuing 积极追求
aggressive.mnemonic: ag+gress(走)+ive → 向你走来 → 侵略的

alleviate.rootAffix: al-(加强)+lev(轻)+-iate → 使变轻 → 减轻

examples.sentence: This medicine should alleviate the pain.
examples.translation: 这种药应当能减轻疼痛。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 This medicine + 情态动词 should + 谓语 alleviate + 宾语 the pain。alleviate 的宾语常为 pain、suffering、problem 等负面事物。

examples.sentence: Although the new policy has alleviated some of the pressure on hospitals, it has done little to address the underlying causes of the shortage of staff.
examples.translation: 尽管新政策缓解了医院的部分压力，但对于人手短缺的根本原因却收效甚微。
examples.analysis: 复合句。Although 引导让步状语从句（现在完成时 has alleviated）；主句 it has done little to address...；underlying causes 后接 of the shortage of staff 作定语。alleviate 强调部分缓解而非根除。

phrases: alleviate...by 通过…缓解
alleviate the situation 缓和局势
alleviate.mnemonic: al+lev(轻)+iate → 使变轻 → 减轻

allocate.rootAffix: al-(向)+loc(地方)+-ate → 安排到某处 → 分配

examples.sentence: The government allocated funds to schools.
examples.translation: 政府向学校拨付了资金。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 The government + 谓语 allocated + 宾语 funds + 状语 to schools。allocate 常用于 allocate sth to sb/sth 结构。

examples.sentence: Decisions about how resources should be allocated are rarely purely technical, since they reflect assumptions about which groups deserve priority.
examples.translation: 关于资源应如何配置的决策很少是纯技术性的，因为这些决策反映了对哪些群体应优先的假设。
examples.analysis: 复合句。主语 Decisions 后接 about how... 介词宾语从句（含被动 should be allocated）；主句 are rarely purely technical；since 引导原因状语从句；从句中 about which groups deserve priority 为「介词 + 关系代词」引导的宾语从句。

phrases: allocate...among 在…之间分配
be allocated for 被拨作…之用
allocate.mnemonic: al+loc(地方)+ate → 安排到各处 → 分配

defs.meaning: 通道，入口；接近（的权利/机会）

access.rootAffix: ac-(去，向)+cess(走，来自拉丁语 cedere) → 走过去的方式 → 通道；have access to 即「得以接近」

examples.sentence: Students have free access to the library.
examples.translation: 学生可以免费使用图书馆。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Students + 谓语 have + 宾语 free access；to the library 是 access 的后置定语（access to… 固定搭配），说明「通往/使用」的对象。

examples.sentence: The internet has given ordinary people access to information that was once available only to a privileged few.
examples.translation: 互联网让普通人得以获取过去只有少数特权阶层才能接触到的信息。
examples.analysis: 主句 The internet has given ordinary people access（双宾语：people 间接宾语 + access 直接宾语）；to information 是 access 的搭配后置定语；that was once available only to a privileged few 是定语从句修饰 information，从句内 available to… 又是形容词短语后置定语，层层嵌套但主线清晰。

collocations: have access to 有权使用；能接近
gain/get access to 获得…的权限
access to education 受教育的机会
phrases: open access 开放获取
access card 门禁卡

derived.meaning: adj. 可接近的；易获取的；（人）好相处的
adj. 达不到的；无法获取的

access.mnemonic: ac(去)+cess(走) → 走得过去 → 通道、权限

account.rootAffix: ac-(去)+count(数，计算) → 逐笔计算 → 账目；引申为「把事情讲个明白 → 叙述、解释」

examples.sentence: She opened a bank account last week.
examples.translation: 她上周开了一个银行账户。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 She + 谓语 opened + 宾语 a bank account，last week 是时间状语。account 取「账户」义。

examples.sentence: Manufacturing accounts for a large share of the region's economy, which explains why job losses there attract so much attention.
examples.translation: 制造业占该地区经济的很大比重，这解释了为什么当地的就业损失引起如此多的关注。
examples.analysis: 主句主语 Manufacturing + 谓语短语 accounts for + 宾语 a large share；of the region's economy 是 share 的后置定语；which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整个主句内容（制造业占比大这件事），从句内 why 引导宾语从句作 explains 的宾语。

collocations: open/close an account 开户/销户
phrases: on account of 由于
by all accounts 据大家所说
keep an account of 记录
account.mnemonic: ac+count(数) → 算账的地方 → 账户；把账算清 → 解释

defs.meaning: 设法解决，处理（问题）（重点义）

address.rootAffix: ad-(向，朝着)+dress(=direct，理正、指向) → 把话头对准 → 向…讲话；对准问题 → 着手处理

examples.sentence: Please write your address on the form.
examples.translation: 请在表格上写下你的地址。
examples.analysis: 简单句：祈使句，谓语 write + 宾语 your address + 地点状语 on the form。

examples.sentence: The government has promised to address the housing shortage, though critics question whether the measures announced so far are sufficient.
examples.translation: 政府已承诺解决住房短缺问题，尽管批评者质疑迄今公布的政策是否足够。
examples.analysis: 主句 The government has promised to address...（不定式作宾语）；though 引导让步状语从句；从句内 whether the measures...are sufficient 是 question 的宾语从句，announced so far 是过去分词短语作 measures 的后置定语。address 在此取「设法解决」义，是阅读高频考点义。

collocations: address the issue/problem 解决问题
address a meeting 在会议上发言
email/home address 电子邮件/家庭地址
phrases: address oneself to 着手处理；致力于
form of address 称呼
address.mnemonic: ad(向)+dress(理正) → 把话对准人 → 演讲；把矛头对准问题 → 解决

defs.meaning: 进步，进展（in advance 预先）

advance.rootAffix: ad-(向前)+vance(=vant，来自拉丁语 vangere 走在前头) → 向前走 → 推进、促进

examples.sentence: You should book tickets in advance.
examples.translation: 你应该提前订票。
examples.analysis: 简单句：谓语 should book + 宾语 tickets；in advance 是固定介词短语作时间状语，意为「预先、事先」。

examples.sentence: Recent advances in artificial intelligence have raised questions that society has not yet begun to answer, let alone agree on.
examples.translation: 人工智能的最新进展提出了社会尚未开始回答、更遑论达成共识的问题。
examples.analysis: 主语 Recent advances（advance 取名词「进展」义，常用复数）+ 谓语 have raised + 宾语 questions；that 引导定语从句修饰 questions；let alone「更不用说」连接 has not begun to answer 和 agree on 两个并列动作，构成递进强调。

collocations: advance in technology 技术进步
advance a theory 提出理论
phrases: in advance of 在…之前
advance notice 预先通知
advance.mnemonic: ad(向前)+vance(先行) → 走在前头 → 前进、进展

advantage.rootAffix: advant(=advance，在前)+age(名词后缀) → 处在前头的状态 → 优势

examples.sentence: Height is an advantage in basketball.
examples.translation: 打篮球时身高是优势。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Height + 系动词 is + 表语 an advantage；in basketball 是方面状语。

examples.sentence: One advantage of studying abroad is that students are forced to use the language every day, which speeds up learning in a way classroom practice rarely can.
examples.translation: 留学的一个好处是学生被迫每天使用该语言，其加速学习的效果是课堂练习很难达到的。
examples.analysis: 主句 One advantage...is that...（表语从句）；that 从句内 are forced to use 是被动结构；which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代前面整个从句内容；in a way...rarely can 中省略了 that 的定语从句修饰 way，can 后省略动词 speed up learning。

collocations: have an advantage over 比…有优势
phrases: to one's advantage 对某人有利
at an advantage 处于有利地位
advantage.mnemonic: advant(在前)+age → 占在前头的便宜 → 优势

analysis.rootAffix: ana-(完全，彻底)+lysis(松开，分解) → 彻底拆开来看 → 分析

examples.sentence: His analysis of the problem was very clear.
examples.translation: 他对这个问题的分析非常清晰。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 His analysis + 系动词 was + 表语 clear；of the problem 是 analysis 的后置定语（analysis of… 分析…）。

examples.sentence: A careful analysis of the data reveals a trend that most previous studies, relying on smaller samples, had failed to detect.
examples.translation: 对数据的仔细分析揭示出一种大多数以往研究——因依赖较小样本——未能发现的趋势。
examples.analysis: 主语 A careful analysis + 谓语 reveals + 宾语 a trend；of the data 是后置定语；that 引导定语从句修饰 trend；relying on smaller samples 是现在分词短语作插入状语，修饰 previous studies；had failed to detect 用过去完成时表示「过去的失败」。

collocations: in the final/last analysis 归根结底
conduct/carry out an analysis 进行分析
phrases: analysis of… 对…的分析
on analysis 经分析

derived.meaning: adj. 分析的；善于分析的

analysis.mnemonic: ana(彻底)+lysis(松开) → 拆解到最细 → 分析

announce.rootAffix: an-(向，to)+nounce(说，报告，拉丁语 nuntius 信使) → 向大家说 → 宣布

examples.sentence: The company announced its new product yesterday.
examples.translation: 公司昨天发布了新产品。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 The company + 谓语 announced + 宾语 its new product + 时间状语 yesterday。

examples.sentence: It was announced that the stadium, whose construction had been delayed for years, would finally open to the public next spring.
examples.translation: 官方宣布：建设拖延了多年的体育场将于明年春天最终向公众开放。
examples.analysis: It 是形式主语，真正主语是 that 从句（It was announced that... 被动语态的「宣布」）；从句主干 the stadium would open；whose construction had been delayed 是定语从句修饰 stadium（whose 指物的所属关系）；would finally open to the public 中 to the public 是开放的对象。

collocations: announce a decision 宣布决定
announce plans to do 宣布打算做
It is announced that... 据宣布
phrases: announce to sb. 向某人宣布
announce.mnemonic: an(向)+nounce(报) → 向众人报信 → 宣布

annual.rootAffix: ann(年，拉丁语 annus)+ual(形容词后缀) → 按年的 → 每年的

examples.sentence: The annual meeting is held in May.
examples.translation: 年会在五月举行。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 The annual meeting + 被动谓语 is held + 时间状语 in May。annual 作定语修饰 meeting。

examples.sentence: The report, published at the group's annual conference, warns that unless spending on training rises, the industry will struggle to attract young talent.
examples.translation: 该报告在集团年会上发布，警告说除非培训支出增加，否则这个行业将难以吸引年轻人才。
examples.analysis: published at...conference 是过去分词短语作主语 The report 的后置定语（补全为 which was published）；谓语 warns + that 宾语从句；从句内 unless 引导条件状语从句，主句是 the industry will struggle to attract...。

phrases: on an annual basis 按年度

derived.meaning: n. 周年纪念（同根 ann）

defs.meaning: 预期，预料（后接名词/doing，不接不定式）

anticipate.rootAffix: anti-(在前，先)+cip(拿，取)+ate(动词后缀) → 提前拿到（消息/局面）→ 预料

examples.sentence: We anticipate strong demand for the new product.
examples.translation: 我们预计新产品需求会很大。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 We + 谓语 anticipate + 宾语 strong demand；for the new product 是 demand 的后置定语。注意 anticipate 后接名词或 doing，不接 to do。

examples.sentence: The reforms were anticipated to bring short-term pain, but few anticipated that the public, having endured years of hardship, would grow so impatient.
examples.translation: 改革被预期会带来短期阵痛，但很少有人预料到，已经忍受了多年困苦的公众会变得如此不耐烦。
examples.analysis: 前半句被动结构 were anticipated to bring（=人们预期它会带来）；but 后主句 few anticipated + that 宾语从句；having endured years of hardship 是完成式分词短语作定语修饰 the public（表先于谓语发生的动作），先「忍受」后「不耐烦」，时序由分词完成式体现。

collocations: anticipate doing sth. 预计做某事
anticipate problems/needs 预见问题/需求
phrases: as anticipated/as was anticipated 如预期那样

derived.meaning: n. 预期（in anticipation of 预料到）

anticipate.mnemonic: anti(先)+cip(拿)+ate → 提前抓到结局 → 预料

defs.meaning: 呼吁，恳求（appeal to sb. for/to do）
有吸引力，使感兴趣（sth. appeals to sb.）

appeal.rootAffix: ap-(向)+peal(推，驱动，拉丁语 pellere) → 把请求推到对方面前 → 呼吁；（感情）被推着走 → 被吸引

examples.sentence: The design appeals to young people.
examples.translation: 这个设计对年轻人有吸引力。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 The design + 谓语 appeals to + 宾语 young people。appeal to sb. = 吸引某人，主动形式表被动意味（被…吸引）。

examples.sentence: Charities increasingly appeal to younger donors through social media, where short videos can spread a message far more cheaply than television advertising ever could.
examples.translation: 慈善机构越来越多地通过社交媒体向年轻捐赠者发出呼吁，因为在社交媒体上，短视频传播信息的成本远低于电视广告。
examples.analysis: 主句 Charities appeal to younger donors through social media；where 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 social media（关系副词 = on which）；从句内 far more cheaply than...ever could 是比较级结构，could 后省略 spread a message。

collocations: appeal to sb. for sth. 为…向某人呼吁
appeal to do sth. 呼吁做某事
appeal to young voters 吸引年轻选民
lodge/file an appeal 提起上诉
phrases: make an appeal 发出呼吁
court of appeal 上诉法院

derived.meaning: adj. 有吸引力的；恳求的

appeal.mnemonic: ap(向)+peal(推) → 把请求推过去 → 呼吁；把心推过去 → 吸引

defs.meaning: 适用（规则对某情况 apply）

apply.rootAffix: ap-(向)+ply(折，弯，拉丁语 plicare) → 把东西贴合到目标上 → 涂敷、应用；把自己贴到一个职位上 → 申请

examples.sentence: I want to apply for the scholarship.
examples.translation: 我想申请奖学金。
examples.analysis: 简单句：谓语 want to apply + for the scholarship（apply for 固定搭配，申请的对象用 for）。

examples.sentence: The rules apply to all students, including those who enrolled before the new policy was introduced.
examples.translation: 这些规定适用于所有学生，包括在新政策出台前入学的那部分学生。
examples.analysis: 主句 The rules apply to all students（apply 取「适用」义）；including 介词化分词引出补充范围；who 引导定语从句修饰 those（那些人）；从句内 before 引导时间状语从句，was introduced 用被动语态表「政策被出台」。

collocations: apply for a job/visa 申请工作/签证
apply the theory to practice 把理论用于实践
phrases: apply oneself to 致力于
apply pressure 施加压力

derived.meaning: n. 申请；应用；应用程序
adj. 应用的（applied mathematics 应用数学）

apply.mnemonic: ap(向)+ply(贴) → 贴上去用 → 应用；把自己贴过去 → 申请

defs.meaning: 接近，靠近（时间/空间/数量）

approach.rootAffix: ap-(向)+proach(近，拉丁语 prope 近) → 向近处走 → 接近；处理问题的「路径」引申为方法

examples.sentence: We need a new approach to the problem.
examples.translation: 我们需要解决这个问题的新方法。
examples.analysis: 简单句：谓语 need + 宾语 a new approach；to the problem 是 approach 的后置定语（approach to… 的固定搭配，注意用 to 不用 of）。

examples.sentence: As winter approaches, the city is racing to complete repairs on roads that were damaged by last summer's floods.
examples.translation: 随着冬季临近，这座城市正争分夺秒地修复去年夏天被洪水损毁的道路。
examples.analysis: As winter approaches 是 as 引导的时间状语从句（approach 取「临近」义）；主句 the city is racing to complete repairs（race to do 抢着做）；on roads 是 repairs 的后置定语；that were damaged... 是定语从句修饰 roads，被动语态。

collocations: approach sb. about sth. 就某事接洽某人
the approach of winter 冬天的临近
phrases: at the approach of 在…快来时

derived.meaning: adj. 易接近的；（人）亲切的

approach.mnemonic: ap(向)+proach(近) → 走近 → 接近；走近的路子 → 方法

defs.meaning: 挪用，盗用（资金）；拨出（款项）（读 /əˈprəʊprieɪt/）

appropriate.rootAffix: ap-(向)+propri(自己的，proprius)+ate → 变成自己的 → 拨归自己用；恰如其分地「归位」→ 恰当的

examples.sentence: Jeans are not appropriate for a formal interview.
examples.translation: 牛仔裤不适合正式面试。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Jeans + 系动词 are + 表语 appropriate；for a formal interview 是方面状语。appropriate for/to 均可表「适合于」。

examples.sentence: Critics argue that it is not appropriate to compare the two countries, whose economies differ in both size and structure.
examples.translation: 批评者认为，拿这两个国家作比较并不恰当，因为它们的经济体量和结构都不同。
examples.analysis: 主句 Critics argue + that 宾语从句；从句内 it 是形式主语，真正主语是不定式 to compare（it is appropriate to do 的否定式）；whose economies differ... 是非限制性定语从句修饰 the two countries，differ in 表「在…方面不同」。

collocations: an appropriate measure 恰当的措施
phrases: where appropriate 在适当的情况下
appropriate.mnemonic: ap+propri(自己)+ate → 归于其位 → 恰当的；归为己有 → 挪用

approve.rootAffix: ap-(向)+prove(证明，拉丁语 probare 测试认可) → 验明可行 → 批准

examples.sentence: Her boss approved the plan.
examples.translation: 她的老板批准了这个计划。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Her boss + 谓语 approved + 宾语 the plan。approve sth. = 批准（及物）；approve of sth. = 赞成（不及物+介词）。

examples.sentence: The committee approved the proposal on condition that all safety standards be met before construction begins.
examples.translation: 委员会批准了该提案，条件是施工开始前所有安全标准都必须达标。
examples.analysis: 主句 The committee approved the proposal；on condition that 引导条件状语从句（= 只要，须满足的条件）；从句内 be met 用虚拟语气原形（表条件性要求），before 引导时间从句。approve 取「批准」义。

collocations: approve a plan/bill 批准计划/法案
approve the budget 批准预算
phrases: on approval （商品）供试用的，包退换的

derived.meaning: n. 批准；赞成（on approval / give approval）

approve.mnemonic: ap+prove(验证) → 验明可行 → 批准、赞成

defs.meaning: 主张，认为（argue that...，论述性观点）
争论，辩论（argue with sb. about sth.）
说服（argue sb. into/out of doing）

argue.rootAffix: argu(=arg，白，拉丁语 argentum 银色→闪亮→说得漂亮) → 把话说亮堂 → 辩论、论证

examples.sentence: They argued about the price for hours.
examples.translation: 他们就价格争了好几个小时。
examples.analysis: 简单句：谓语 argued + about the price（争论的内容用 about）+ for hours（持续的时间状语，注意 for 表时长）。

examples.sentence: Supporters argue that the tax will reduce pollution, but opponents counter that it will hurt low-income families, who spend a larger share of their income on fuel.
examples.translation: 支持者主张这项税收会减少污染，但反对者反驳说它会伤害低收入家庭，因为这些家庭在燃料上的支出占收入的比重更大。
examples.analysis: 并列结构：argue that... but counter that...（counter 反驳，也是「主张」类动词）；第一个 that 从句主谓宾 the tax will reduce pollution；第二个 that 从句内 who spend... 是定语从句修饰 low-income families；a larger share of their income on fuel 是 spend...on 结构。阅读议论文高频句式。

collocations: argue with sb. about sth. 与某人争辩某事
argue the case 论证观点
phrases: argue sb. into doing 说服某人做
argue sb. out of doing 说服某人不做

derived.meaning: n. 争论；论点（have an argument）

argue.mnemonic: arg(亮)+ue → 把话说得漂亮 → 辩论、主张

defs.meaning: （问题、机会等）出现，发生（不及物）

arise.rootAffix: a-(加强)+rise(升起) → 升起来 → 出现；注意过去式 arose、过去分词 arisen（不规则变化）

examples.sentence: Problems arose during the project.
examples.translation: 项目进行中出现了问题。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Problems + 不及物动词 arose（过去式）+ 时间状语 during the project。arise 不能用于被动语态。

examples.sentence: Should any dispute arise from this contract, the two parties agree to settle it through arbitration rather than litigation.
examples.translation: 如因本合同产生任何争议，双方同意通过仲裁而非诉讼解决。
examples.analysis: Should any dispute arise... 是把 if 省略后的倒装虚拟条件句（= If any dispute should arise...，正式书面语）；arise from 表「由…产生」；主句 the two parties agree to settle...；rather than 连接 arbitration 与 litigation 表取舍。

collocations: should the need arise 如有需要
phrases: arise naturally 自然而然地产生

derived.meaning: adj. 产生的（issues arising 由此产生的问题）

arise.易混辨析: arise（问题出现，不及物）/ rise（升起）/ raise（举起，及物）/ arouse（唤起，及物）——考研经典四辨
arise.mnemonic: a+rise(升) → （无形之物）升起来 → 出现、产生

defs.meaning: 评估，评定（价值、质量、程度）

assess.rootAffix: as-(向)+sess(坐，拉丁语 sedere) →（法官）坐下来核定 → 评估、评定

examples.sentence: Teachers assess students' progress each term.
examples.translation: 老师每学期评估学生的进步。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Teachers + 谓语 assess + 宾语 students' progress + 时间状语 each term。

examples.sentence: It is too early to assess the full impact of the policy, whose effects will not be visible for several years.
examples.translation: 现在评估这项政策的全部影响还为时过早，其效果要几年后才会显现。
examples.analysis: It 是形式主语，真正主语是不定式 to assess the full impact（assess 取「评估」义）；whose effects will not be visible 是非限制性定语从句修饰 the policy；for several years 表持续时间。

collocations: assess the impact/situation 评估影响/形势
phrases: assess sb.'s ability 评定某人的能力

derived.meaning: n. 评估（risk assessment 风险评估）

assess.易混辨析: assess（估出价值/程度）/ access（通道、访问）/ excess（过量）——拼写相近，词义全不同，考研阅读高频陷阱
assess.mnemonic: as+sess(坐) → 坐下来核定 → 评估

defs.meaning: 假定，假设（认为成立而未证实）
承担（职务、责任）；呈现（样子）
装出，摆出（assume an air of）

assume.rootAffix: as-(向)+sume(拿，取，拉丁语 sumere) → 拿来当真 → 假定；把责任拿到身上 → 承担

examples.sentence: I assumed he was sick because he didn't come.
examples.translation: 他没来，我以为他病了。
examples.analysis: 主句 I assumed + (that) 宾语从句 he was sick（从句引导词 that 省略）；because 引导原因状语从句。assume 取「想当然地认为」义。

examples.sentence: The theory rests on the assumption that consumers behave rationally, an assumption that has been challenged by behavioral economists.
examples.translation: 该理论建立在消费者理性行事的假设之上，而这一假设已受到行为经济学家的挑战。
examples.analysis: 主句 The theory rests on the assumption（rest on 建立在）；that consumers behave rationally 是 assumption 的同位语从句（说明假设的内容）；an assumption that... 是同位语重复强调，that 引导定语从句修饰它（注意区分同位语从句 that 后接完整句 vs 定语从句 that 在从句中充当成分）。

collocations: assume responsibility/power 承担责任/掌权
phrases: assuming (that)... 假设…（引导条件）

derived.meaning: n. 假定；承担（on the assumption that 在…的假设下）

assume.易混辨析: assume（未证实地假定）/ presume（有依据地推定）/ consume（消耗）/ resume（恢复）——同根 sume 四兄弟
assume.mnemonic: as+sume(拿) → 拿来当前提 → 假定；拿过来 → 承担

defs.meaning: attach importance to 重视（固定搭配，高频考点）
使附属，使隶属于（be attached to）

attach.rootAffix: at-(向)+tach(拴，钉，法语 attachier) → 拴到…上 → 附上、系上

examples.sentence: Please attach a photo to the form.
examples.translation: 请在表格上贴一张照片。
examples.analysis: 简单句：祈使句，谓语 attach + 宾语 a photo + to the form（attach A to B 把 A 附到 B 上）。

examples.sentence: Parents who attach too much importance to academic results may overlook their children's emotional needs, which are equally vital to healthy development.
examples.translation: 过分看重学业成绩的父母可能忽视孩子的情感需求，而情感需求对健康成长同样重要。
examples.analysis: 主语 Parents + who 引导定语从句（attach importance to 重视——名词 importance 作宾语，to 引出重视的对象）；主句谓语 may overlook + 宾语 emotional needs；which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 emotional needs（指物用 which 指代复数需求）。

collocations: be attached to 依恋；隶属于
attached please find 随函附上（公文用语）
phrases: attach a document 附上文件
attach label 贴标签

derived.meaning: n. 附件；依恋（email attachment 邮件附件）

attach.mnemonic: at+tach(拴) → 拴在一起 → 附上、依恋

defs.meaning: 达到，实现（目标、水平）；获得（正式）

attain.rootAffix: at-(向)+tain(触，握，拉丁语 tangere) → 触摸到目标 → 达到、获得

examples.sentence: She attained the highest score in the class.
examples.translation: 她取得了全班最高分。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 She + 谓语 attained + 宾语 the highest score + 范围状语 in the class。attain 是正式用词。

examples.sentence: Only by setting realistic goals can students attain a sense of achievement that motivates further effort.
examples.translation: 只有设定切合实际的目标，学生才能获得激励他们继续努力的成就感。
examples.analysis: Only by + 动名词置于句首引起部分倒装：can students attain（正常语序 students can attain）；a sense of achievement 是宾语；that motivates further effort 是定语从句修饰 a sense of achievement。only 状语前置倒装是写作高分句型。

collocations: attain a goal/objective 达成目标
attain the age of 到达…岁数
phrases: attain to（正式）达到（水平）

derived.meaning: n. 达到；成就（educational attainments 学业成就）

attain.易混辨析: attain（经努力达到）/ obtain（得到）/ contain（包含）/ maintain（维持）/ sustain（支撑）——同根 tain 五兄弟
attain.mnemonic: at+tain(触) → 够得着 → 达到、获得

defs.meaning: 尝试，试图（attempt to do / doing，正式用词）
尝试，努力（an attempt at/to do）

attempt.rootAffix: at-(向)+tempt(尝试、试探，拉丁语 temptare) → 去试一试 → 尝试

examples.sentence: He attempted to break the record.
examples.translation: 他试图打破纪录。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 He + 谓语 attempted + 不定式 to break 作宾语。attempt to do = 试图做，比 try 正式。

examples.sentence: Despite several failed attempts to reach the summit, the team remained convinced that another expedition was worth the risk.
examples.translation: 尽管登顶的几次尝试都失败了，队伍仍然确信再来一次探险值得冒险。
examples.analysis: Despite 介词后接名词短语 several failed attempts（attempt 作名词）；to reach the summit 是 attempts 的后置定语（an attempt to do 的名词用法）；that another expedition was worth the risk 是 convinced 的宾语从句；be worth + 名词/doing 表「值得」。

collocations: attempt to do sth. 试图做某事
make an attempt 尝试一下
a failed/successful attempt 失败/成功的尝试
attempt the impossible 试图做不可能的事
phrases: in an attempt to do 试图…（目的状语）
at the first attempt 第一次尝试就

derived.meaning: adj. 未遂的（attempted murder 杀人未遂）

attempt.易混辨析: attempt（正式，常含失败可能）/ try（口语常用）/ manage（设法办成）——attempt 强调「付出了努力」，结果未必成功

attend.rootAffix: at-(向)+tend(伸展，朝向，拉丁语 tendere) → 把心伸向 → 出席、照料；同根 tend（趋向）、trend（趋势）

examples.sentence: Over 200 people attended the conference.
examples.translation: 两百多人出席了这次会议。
examples.analysis: 简单句：Over 200 people 是主语 + 谓语 attended + 宾语 the conference。attend 是及物动词，直接接宾语，不加 to。

examples.sentence: Students who attend top universities are not necessarily those with the best grades, but often those who made the most of what their schools offered.
examples.translation: 上顶尖大学的学生未必是成绩最好的那批，而往往是那些充分利用了学校资源的学生。
examples.analysis: 主语 Students + who 定语从句 attend top universities；not necessarily...but often... 表「未必…而往往…」的让步对比；who made the most of... 是第二个定语从句修饰 those；make the most of 充分利用；what their schools offered 是 of 的宾语从句。

collocations: attend a meeting/class 出席会议/上课
phrases: attend to one's own business 管好自己的事

derived.meaning: n. 出席（人数）（attendance rate 出勤率）
n. 服务员 adj. 随之而来的（attendant risks 伴随的风险）

attend.易混辨析: attend（出席，及物）/ attend to（照料）/ tend（趋向；照料）/ intend（打算）——同根 tend 四兄弟
attend.mnemonic: at+tend(伸向) → 身心到位 → 出席、照料

attitude.rootAffix: apt(=att，适合、倾向，拉丁语 aptus)+itude(名词后缀，表状态) → 心理的倾向 → 态度

examples.sentence: His attitude toward work has changed.
examples.translation: 他对工作的态度变了。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 His attitude + 系动词 has changed；toward work 是 attitude 的后置定语（attitude toward/to… 对…的态度）。

examples.sentence: What matters most is not what happens to us but how we respond, for our attitude shapes our experience far more than circumstances do.
examples.translation: 最重要的不是我们遭遇了什么，而是我们如何应对，因为态度对经历的影响远大于环境。
examples.analysis: What matters most 是主语从句；not...but... 并连两个表语（what happens to us / how we respond——都是名词性从句）；for 引导并列分句表原因（口语/书面常用，弱于 because）；far more than circumstances do 是比较级结构，do 代替 shape our experience。

collocations: a positive/negative attitude 积极/消极态度
adopt/take an attitude 采取态度
change one's attitude 改变态度
phrases: with an attitude of 带着…的态度
attitude.易混辨析: attitude（内心态度）/ altitude（高度）/ gratitude（感激）/ longitude（经度）/ latitude（纬度）——itude 同缀五兄弟，考研拼写陷阱
attitude.mnemonic: att(倾向)+itude(状态) → 心之所向 → 态度

defs.meaning: 当局，官方（the authorities，常用复数）
权威人士/机构；许可（an authority on…）

authority.rootAffix: author(创造者、创始人，拉丁语 auctor)+ity(名词后缀) → 创始者说的话算数 → 权威、权力

examples.sentence: She is an authority on ancient history.
examples.translation: 她是古代史方面的权威。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 She + 系动词 is + 表语 an authority；on ancient history（某领域的权威用介词 on）。

examples.sentence: The authorities, who had been criticized for their slow response, defended the measures taken, arguing that public safety had been the top priority throughout.
examples.translation: 此前因反应迟缓而受到批评的当局为已采取的措施辩护，称公共安全始终是首要考量。
examples.analysis: 主语 The authorities + 非限制性定语从句 who had been criticized for...（被动完成时， criticized for 表「因…受批评」）；主句谓语 defended + 宾语 the measures taken（taken 过去分词后置 = 被采取的）；arguing that... 是现在分词作伴随状语，that 从句用过去完成被动 had been the top priority。

collocations: an authority on 在…方面的权威
under the authority of 在…的管辖下
phrases: have the authority to do 有权做某事
abuse authority 滥用职权
authority.易混辨析: author（作者）/ authority（权威）/ authentic（真的）/ autobiography（自传）——author 同根，注意 authoritative（权威的）与 author（作者）词义关联
authority.mnemonic: author(创造者)+ity → 说了算的人 → 权威、当局

available.rootAffix: a-(向)+vail(价值，拉丁语 valere 值)+able(可…的) → 能发挥价值的 → 可用的

examples.sentence: Tickets are available at the door.
examples.translation: 票可在门口购买（现场有售）。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Tickets + 系动词 are + 表语 available；at the door 是地点状语。available 作表语是最高频用法。

examples.sentence: With more information available online than ever before, the real challenge is no longer finding data but judging which of it can be trusted.
examples.translation: 随着网上可获得的信息比以往任何时候都多，真正的挑战不再是找到数据，而是判断哪些数据可信。
examples.analysis: With + 名词 +形容词 的独立结构（With more information available）作背景状语；than ever before 是比较状语的省略形式；主句表语从句 no longer...but... 对比表语；which of it can be trusted 是 judging 的宾语从句（it 指 information）。

collocations: be available to sb. 对某人可用
widely available 到处都能买到的
phrases: available resources 可用资源
make...available 使…可获得

derived.meaning: adj. 不可获得的；无空档的
v./n. 有用于（of no avail 毫无用处）

available.易混辨析: available（可用的）/ valuable（贵重的）/ prevalent（流行的）——拼写相近；available 修饰「物=可获得、人=有空」
available.mnemonic: a+vail(价值)+able → 拿来就能用 → 可获得的

balance.rootAffix: ba(=bi，两，拉丁语 bis)+lance(秤盘) → 两头称量 → 平衡；两头相比较 → 权衡

examples.sentence: Try to keep a balance between work and rest.
examples.translation: 尽量在工作和休息之间保持平衡。
examples.analysis: 祈使句：谓语 Try to keep + 宾语 a balance；between...and... 说明平衡的两端（balance between A and B 固定搭配）。

examples.sentence: Governments must balance the need for economic growth against the imperative of protecting the environment, a task that becomes harder as populations expand.
examples.translation: 政府必须在经济增长需求与保护环境的紧迫性之间取得平衡——随着人口增长，这项任务愈发艰巨。
examples.analysis: 主句 balance A against B（把 A 与 B 权衡，固定搭配）；a task that... 是同位语，补充说明整个主句；that becomes harder 是定语从句修饰 a task；as populations expand 是 as 引导的时间/原因状语从句。

collocations: balance A against/and B 权衡 A 与 B
keep/lose one's balance 保持/失去平衡
on balance 总的来说（权衡之后）
phrases: out of balance 失衡
strike a balance 取得折中

derived.meaning: adj. 均衡的（a balanced diet 均衡饮食）
n. 不平衡（trade imbalance 贸易失衡）
adj. 失衡的；精神失常的

balance.易混辨析: balance（平衡，名词为主）/ balcony（阳台）/ ballot（选票）——拼写开头相近；on balance 是阅读高频短语「总的来说」
balance.mnemonic: ba(两)+lance(秤) → 两头称平 → 平衡、权衡

defs.meaning: 好处，益处（可数）；福利（救济金，常用复数）
使受益（及物）；受益（benefit from/by，不及物）

benefit.rootAffix: bene-(好，善，拉丁语 bene)+fit(做，fili) → 做好事 → 益处；同根 benefit/benevolent（仁慈的）/benefactor（恩人）

examples.sentence: Regular exercise benefits your health.
examples.translation: 经常锻炼有益健康。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Regular exercise + 及物谓语 benefits + 宾语 your health。benefit 直接接宾语表「使受益」，不加 from。

examples.sentence: The students who benefit most from online learning are those who can manage their own time, a skill that traditional classrooms rarely teach explicitly.
examples.translation: 从在线学习中受益最多的学生，是那些能够自我管理时间的学生——传统课堂很少明确传授这种能力。
examples.analysis: 主语 The students + who 定语从句（benefit most from... 受益最多，benefit from 固定搭配）；are those... 表语后接 who 定语从句；a skill that... 是同位语，that 引导定语从句修饰 a skill；rarely explicitly 副词修饰 teach。

collocations: reap the benefits 收获好处
phrases: for the benefit of 为了…的利益
at no extra benefit 无额外好处的
benefit.易混辨析: benefit（好处）/ beneficial（有益的，形容词）/ benevolent（仁慈的）/ beneficiary（受益人）——bene 同根「好」家族
benefit.mnemonic: bene(好)+fit(做) → 做出好处 → 益处、受益

defs.meaning: 运动（有组织的系列活动）；战役

campaign.rootAffix: camp(田野，军营，拉丁语 campus)+aign → 从军营出发的行动 → 战役；引申为有组织的「运动」

examples.sentence: They launched a campaign against smoking.
examples.translation: 他们发起了一场反对吸烟的运动。
examples.analysis: 简单句：谓语 launched + 宾语 a campaign + against smoking（反对…的运动，against 表对象）。launch/campaign 搭配高频。

examples.sentence: The campaign, which was funded largely by small individual donations, proved that grassroots movements could compete with well-financed opponents.
examples.translation: 这场主要由个人小额捐款资助的运动证明，草根行动可以与资金雄厚的对手抗衡。
examples.analysis: 主语 The campaign + 非限制性定语从句 which was funded by...（被动语态，largely 修饰 funded）；主句谓语 proved + that 宾语从句；从句是 A could compete with B 结构（compete with 与…抗衡）；well-financed 复合形容词修饰 opponents。

collocations: launch/run a campaign 发起/开展运动
a campaign against/for 反对/争取…的运动
phrases: campaign for/against 为/反对…而奔走

derived.meaning: n. 运动参与者；活动家

campaign.易混辨析: campaign（有组织的运动/战役）/ champion（冠军；拥护）/ champagne（香槟）——拼写相近；「运动」义是考研高频
campaign.mnemonic: camp(营)+aign → 从营地出发的行动 → 战役、运动

defs.meaning: 有能力的，能干的（capable of doing）
（事物）可以…的；有可能做出（好的或坏的）

capable.rootAffix: cap(容纳、抓取，拉丁语 capere)+able(可…的) → 装得下、抓得住 → 有能力的；同根 capacity（容量、能力）

examples.sentence: She is capable of running a marathon.
examples.translation: 她有能力跑马拉松。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 She + 系动词 is + 表语 capable；of running a marathon 是 capable 的搭配补足语——capable of + doing（动名词），不能接不定式。

examples.sentence: The new chip is capable of processing images at speeds that were once thought impossible for machines of this size.
examples.translation: 新芯片处理图像的速度，曾被认为是这种尺寸的机器不可能达到的。
examples.analysis: 主语 The new chip + is capable of processing（capable of + doing）；at speeds 是速度状语；that were once thought impossible 是定语从句修饰 speeds（think sth. impossible 的被动式：speeds were thought impossible）；for machines of this size 是逻辑主语补足。

collocations: be capable of doing 有能力做
a capable manager 能干的经理
phrases: capable of anything 什么都做得出来（好/坏）
capable.易混辨析: capable of doing（接 of+动名词）/ able to do（接不定式）——固定搭配差异是考点；capable 还可表「有可能（干坏事）」
capable.mnemonic: cap(容纳)+able → 装得下任务 → 有能力的

defs.meaning: 向…挑战；质疑，反对（观点、权威）
考验，激励（挑战某人的能力）

challenge.rootAffix: chal(=calumny，诬告、指控，古法语 chalonge) → 指名叫阵 → 挑战；对说法「叫板」→ 质疑

examples.sentence: Learning a language is a real challenge for adults.
examples.translation: 学语言对成年人是个真正的挑战。
examples.analysis: 简单句：主语 Learning a language（动名词短语作主语）+ 系动词 is + 表语 a real challenge；for adults 是对象状语。

examples.sentence: What makes the problem particularly difficult is that the new evidence challenges long-held assumptions about how memory works, assumptions few researchers were willing to question.
examples.translation: 这个问题之所以特别棘手，是因为新证据挑战了关于记忆如何运作的长期假设——而几乎没有研究者愿意质疑这些假设。
examples.analysis: What makes...difficult 是主语从句（what = the thing that）；is that... 表语从句；从句内 challenges long-held assumptions（challenge 取「质疑」义，long-held 复合形容词）；about how memory works 是 assumptions 的后置定语（内嵌 how 宾语从句）；assumptions few researchers... 是同位语+定语从句省略 that 的紧缩形式。

collocations: face/pose a challenge 面临/构成挑战
challenge the assumption/idea 质疑假设/观点
take up the challenge 接受挑战
meet the challenge 应对挑战
phrases: rise to the challenge 迎战挑战
challenge sb. to do 激某人比试做

derived.meaning: adj. 有挑战性的（a challenging task）

challenge.易混辨析: challenge（挑战；质疑）/ challenge 的「质疑」义是阅读常考——「challenge the authority」不是「挑战权威的身体」而是「质疑权威」
challenge.mnemonic: chal(叫阵)+lenge → 叫板 → 挑战；叫板说法 → 质疑
